qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/raw-evidence-index.json (scope statement only; its artifact hashes were not re-verified because none bears on this row)
evidence: Static configuration row; every clause checked against the frozen bytes. (1) Isolation: task/task.toml:28 `environment_mode = "separate"`; task.toml:37-38 `[verifier.environment] network_mode = "public"`, no allowlist (correct under the delivery profile). (2) Credential block: task.toml:30-35 is `REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code"`, `REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx"`, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api"`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`. A byte comparison shows the five lines are identical to the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md:66-71 (which only adds a trailing comment on the header line), and everything from `[verifier]` to end of file is byte-equal to the frozen template task.toml; the diff between template and task task.toml touches only lines 5-7, 10-12 and 14-15 (name/description/keywords/metadata). LF endings, no CR. The token is an unexpanded `${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}` placeholder, and a grep of the task for sk-or-/sk-ant-/OPENROUTER/ANTHROPIC_ finds only task.toml:31-35 and test.sh:63-64, so no literal credential is present. (3) Pinned image: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template tests/Dockerfile; bases `node:22-bookworm-slim` and `python:3.12-slim` (lines 1-2), npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281`, `@openai/codex@0.151.0`, `@playwright/mcp@0.0.79`, `express@5.1.0`, `better-sqlite3@12.4.1` (lines 17-21), pip `harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7` (line 31), Chromium installed through the pinned Playwright CLI (lines 34-35). The image copies only its own /tests (line 43). (4) judge.toml: all five files have `judge = "claude-code"` at line 2 and no `model`, `reasoning_effort` or `temperature` key (grep over tests/*/*/judge.toml and scoring.toml returns nothing). (5) test.sh is byte-identical to the template and refuses to grade without REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL (lines 63-66). Observations that are not defects for this row: base images are pinned by tag rather than digest and apt packages are unversioned (Dockerfile:12-14) - both are template-controlled, and deterministic-checks treats unpinned apt as NOTE-only. Limitation: no configured judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index.json scope is scripted golden only), so actual resolution of OPENROUTER_API_KEY and reachability of z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx through OpenRouter is unmeasured; that is runtime evidence owned by the launch/grading rows, not a wiring defect here. Adversarial attempts: a per-dimension model override, a hard-coded key, a shared-mode verifier, or an edited base URL would each fail this row; none is present. A conforming alternative cannot fail this row because the block is template-controlled and unchanged.
